title: Measure Yourself First
summary: Rabban Gamliel's tube for measuring two thousand amos, and the Gemara's way to know how tall a tree is: measure yourself and your shadow. The talmid who wandered out of the techum while lost in his learning, those who go out to save lives, Dovid at Keilah, and why every town in galus is a border town. Then Shabbos gathering in the sparks of the week, the Me'aras Hamachpelah, why Nimrod was called Amrafel, "a new king who did not know Yosef," and Rabbi Bomzer's thanks after his bypass.
key_ideas: To know how great a tzaddik is, first measure yourself.
One who goes out to save lives on Shabbos may return to his place.
Shabbos gathers in the sparks of the whole week and raises them.
A person can get used to anything, good or bad, so get used to the good.

sources.title: Rabbi Bomzer and the Rebbe after his bypass
